title: Bankrot bo'lgan savdogar 1 yildan keyin nima chiqardi?

scenes.text: 1875 yilda amerikalik Genri Xaynsning birinchi kompaniyasi bankrot bo'ldi.
Bu ish 1869 yilda boshlangan edi. U shisha idishlarda xren qaylasi sotardi.
Bir yil o'tib, 1876 yilda u akasi va amakivachchasi bilan yangi kompaniya ochdi.
Ularning ilk mahsulotlaridan biri pomidor ketchupi edi.
Bugun Heinz nomi dunyodagi eng taniqli ketchup brendlaridan biri.

description:
Genri Xaynsning 1869 yilda Pensilvaniyada boshlagan birinchi kompaniyasi 1875 yilda bankrot bo'lgan. 1876 yilda u akasi Jon va amakivachchasi Frederik bilan yangi kompaniya ochgan, ilk mahsulotlaridan biri pomidor ketchupi bo'lgan.

Muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan keyin qayta boshlash qiyinmi? Izohda fikringizni yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-22 (via web search summaries; direct page fetch was blocked). Britannica: Heinz Company / Henry J. Heinz, https://www.britannica.com/money/Henry-John-Heinz (first company, a partnership formed in Sharpsburg, Pennsylvania in 1869, failed in the 1875 panic; F. & J. Heinz formed 1876 with brother John and cousin Frederick; ketchup first sold in 1876); Wikipedia: Henry J. Heinz, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Henry_J._Heinz (Heinz & Noble, horseradish in clear glass bottles, bankrupt 1875); Scientific American, https://www.scientificamerican.com/blog/anthropology-in-practice/seeing-is-believing-the-story-behind-henry-heinzs-condiment-empire/ (filing in December 1875); The Henry Ford collections, https://www.thehenryford.org/collections-and-research/digital-collections/archival-collections/443713 (F. & J. Heinz; tomato ketchup among its first products). Note: while Heinz was in bankruptcy his brother and cousin were the formal owners and he managed the firm.
